{
  "scope": "P18 prerequisite: shared source identity for the common measured-endpoint channel",
  "kind": "measurement_provenance_support_not_an_additional_probability_gate_trial",
  "source_parent": "f843257fc69794ce9d53c951b033693ac5d6547a",
  "reason": "Real-library diagnostic proves window-local frame ordinal cannot identify the same ray across hypotheses. A common likelihood must condition all queries on the same physical measurement rather than multiply marginal relations.",
  "design": "Assign each newly acquired stored frame a disjoint process-local interval of measurement indices; pixel index chooses a member. Replacing the same timestamp on the same sensor/image grid preserves acquisition identity. Immutable snapshot still chooses the measurement version. Different stores and post-clear acquisitions have distinct intervals. Projection reports source timestamp and stable index. Existing projected counting uses the index.",
  "probabilistic_role": "One random endpoint variable per source acquisition/pixel; identity is deterministic provenance, not q, a new sensor factor, or a confidence value. Shared rounding phase must later be integrated once.",
  "unchanged_decision_proof": "For every single frozen query, old (window ordinal,pixel) and new source index are injective labels for the same finite set. Replacing labels preserves each support/contradiction set cardinality, every per-sample vote, latest support, calibration input and state decision. All current consumers read these sets only for counts. Proxy ray-index namespace remains distinct; no consumer will combine proxy/projected indices.",
  "resources": "One size_t per stored frame and two scalar fields per transient projection; no raw images, per-ray ledger or persistent sidecar; one constant-time atomic interval allocation per newly acquired frame.",
  "constants": "No physical/probability constant. SIZE_MAX is the existing invalid-index representational sentinel; exhaustion rejects insertion without wrapping. Fixed input sampling and classification unchanged.",
  "validation": [
    "Existing25 tests after canonical rebuild",
    "Source identity invariance across query windows and backdated insertion",
    "Distinct timestamps/pixels/stores/clear scopes remain distinct",

    "Existing support/contradiction counts unchanged"
